interactive.label: TTTR Split / Convert
interactive.tooltip: Split large TTTR files into segments and convert between container formats.

interactive.label: ⇄ .pto
interactive.tooltip: Pack a vendor photon file into a .pto container, or unpack the vendor file back out of one. Either direction keeps the dropped file and verifies the result byte-for-byte before anything is deleted.

interactive.label: PTO Inspector
interactive.tooltip: Read a .pto back: every object in it, the payload as a table or a curve, the settings that are the recipe, and the provenance drawn as a graph. Opens the tool that performs a step.

interactive.label: TTTR header
interactive.tooltip: View and edit the header tags of any TTTR file tttrlib can read — correcting metadata a vendor wrote, and adding tags of your own.

interactive.label: TTTR → Time Windows
interactive.tooltip: Split TTTR files into fixed-duration time-window BID (.bst) files.

interactive.label: BID → Analysis
interactive.tooltip: Convert burst-ID (BID) files into a burstwise analysis folder next to the TTTR data.

interactive.label: ✂ Convert / Split
interactive.tooltip: Split the loaded TTTR file into the output folder, one file per photon chunk, converting the container format when it differs.

interactive.label: Split into files
interactive.tooltip: Split into photon chunks; disable to write a single converted file.

interactive.label: Reset macro times
interactive.tooltip: Restart the macro-time clock at zero for each output file.

interactive.label: Keep original
interactive.tooltip: Keep the input file; disabling deletes it after successful writing.
